summary: Full E2E validation of 8 pre-Play-Store hardening tasks on IMORA Tchad. 22/22 pytest backend tests pass. Frontend E2E confirms scam banner (FR/EN/AR), report modal (7 reasons + toast + backend persistence), Terms page (12 sections + required phrases), pagination header wiring, and service worker registration. No regressions detected.

issues: Only 11 properties in preview DB — Load More button correctly hidden (items < PAGE_SIZE=12). Manual scale test recommended once DB has >12 active listings.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1560 lines — still recommended to split into routers (auth/properties/admin/reports/ai) to stay under 700-line guideline.
Report system: property_id validated but no rate-limiting on POST /api/properties/{id}/report — anonymous spam risk. Consider IP-based sliding-window (same pattern as AI chat rate limiter).

Report reason is stored as translated string from frontend (e.g. 'Arnaque suspectée'), not a stable enum code. Admin queue will show mixed languages depending on reporter's i18n. Prefer storing canonical enum ('scam','fake',…) alongside display label.
Frontend Publish.jsx: photos array stored as base64 in Mongo — with 10 photos × 220KB = 2.2MB per property document. Consider migrating to object storage (S3-compatible) before scale-up.
Service worker not audited in this pass — TASK 5 relies on existing SW; a fresh audit of cache freshness/invalidation should be scheduled.
seed_data_creation: One test report created via POST /api/properties/{id}/report on an existing property to exercise admin list + status update flow. Report id preserved in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_hardening.py /app/backend/tests/test_security_fixes.py -v` for full regression (41 tests total). Preview DB has 11 active properties — pagination Load More visibility can only be observed after adding a 13th active listing. TASK 5 (service worker caching) not deeply audited — SW is registered but cache invalidation strategy not tested.
